name: Loreainsworth Quotes & Testimonials Studio
author: Errol Ainsworth Williams

sections.description:
Loreainsworth Quotes & Testimonials Studio is a complete free plugin for presenting meaningful words and responsibly moderated experiences.

Visit the plugin website.

Create as many quotation posts as you need. Display them with responsive cards, four coordinated colour styles, essential typography and layout controls, images, audio, video, search, topic filtering, sorting, pagination, copying and sharing.

The testimonial tools let administrators publish approved testimonials and provide a simple public submission form. Submissions require consent, remain private until reviewed and arrive with Pending Review status.

The plugin uses standard WordPress posts, excerpts, featured images, taxonomies, settings and shortcodes. It does not require an external account or subscription.

Free shortcodes:

  • [loreainsworth_quotes] displays the quotation collection.
  • [loreainsworth_testimonials] displays approved testimonials.
  • [loreainsworth_experience_form] displays the moderated testimonial form.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Loreainsworth Quotes & Testimonials Studio.
  3. Open Settings > Loreainsworth Studio and choose your design.
  4. Create posts and assign the Quotes category.
  5. Use the post Excerpt for the quotation and the Title for its source or author.
  6. Add [loreainsworth_quotes] to a page or Divi Code module.
sections.faq:
Is the Free edition time-limited?

No. The Free edition has no expiry date and supports unlimited manually created quotation posts and testimonials.

What happens to public testimonial submissions?

They are stored as Pending Review. Nothing appears publicly until an administrator checks and publishes it.

Can I move to Pro without losing content?

Yes. Deactivate Free before activating Pro. Both editions use compatible WordPress content types and settings, so quotation posts, testimonials and compatible design choices remain stored.

What does Pro add?

Pro adds the 600-quotation library, personal library management, Bible versions, advanced testimonial experiences, twelve design styles, expanded motion, author portraits, daily quotations, image downloads, backups and specialist management tools.
